answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent registers one identity and posts one heartbeat per round. The beacon draws a random sample for a spot-check due in minutes. A saffron trader and a falcon keeper each keep one heartbeat, not a thousand. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA per round (1,000 x 30 POA), plus 60 POA lost per missed check. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
